The '''Gengh-Noghri''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tulpaa]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], distinguishable by their crocodilian heads filled with flesh-tearing teeth and were over two meters in height, and were the descendents of Noghri slaves taken by ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to the Tulpaa years before the fall of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Daniel Wallace]], the Gengh-Noghri were intended to be a "tip of the hat" to [[Olivier Vatine]]'s depiction of the Noghri's in the [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Heir to the Empire'' comic adaptation]], which differed from how the Noghri were described in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Heir to the Empire|original novel]].<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-unknown-regions.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions|date=2010-04-19}}</ref>
